assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 HAR PAL GEO 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Geo Entertainment / Geo Group / 与 Hamdard Laboratories 的关联。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（以乌尔都语为主）。
  6. 主要内容类别（巴基斯坦电视连续剧／娱乐）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，HAR PAL GEO 排名第 17 名/第 18 名，历史累计观看量约为 85B（850 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 HAR PAL GEO 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
HAR PAL GEO YouTube channel dossier:

(1) STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL:

  • Channel ID: UCe9JSDmyqNgA_l2BzGHq1Ug
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCe9JSDmyqNgA_l2BzGHq1Ug
  • Handle: @HarPalGeoOfficial
    Sources: Social Blade (socialblade.com/youtube/handle/harpalgeoofficial), Viewstats (viewstats.com/@harpalgeoofficial/channelytics)

(2) OPERATOR AND CORPORATE CHAIN:

  • Direct operator: Geo Entertainment, part of Geo Television Network
  • Parent: Jang Media Group (also known as 'Geo Group'), headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan
  • Ultimate parent: Independent Media Corporation (Private) Limited, Dubai-based
  • Ultimate controller: Mir Shakil-ur-Rahman ('MSR') and family, who control 99.90% through shares and debentures
  • Key people: Mir Ibrahim Rahman (CEO, Geo Television Network), Abdullah Kadwani (GMD)
  • FOUNDING: Mir Khalil-ur-Rahman founded Jang Group; his son Mir Shakil-ur-Rahman founded Geo TV network in May 2002
  • HAMARD LABORATORIES CONNECTION: NONE FOUND. Extensive searches across Wikipedia, Media Ownership Monitor, corporate filings, and news sources confirm Hamdard Laboratories (Pakistan) is an entirely separate Unani pharmaceutical company based in Karachi. No ownership, sponsorship, or operational link exists between Hamdard and the Geo/Jang Media Group.
    Sources: Wikipedia (Geo Entertainment, Geo Television Network, Mir Shakil-ur-Rahman), Media Ownership Monitor (pakistan.mom-gmr.org), YouTube Creator Blog

(3) CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST PUBLIC UPLOAD:

  • Channel created: January 2, 2008 (confirmed by Social Blade, Wikitubia, YouTube Creator Blog)
  • Upload activity began 2008–2014, but most early videos were removed on January 6, 2017
  • First public video: January 25, 2016 (per Wikitubia). Exact title/URL not independently verifiable via search; may be an early drama clip or show episode from that period.
    Sources: Social Blade, Wikitubia (youtube.fandom.com/wiki/HAR_PAL_GEO), YouTube Creator Blog

(4) OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY:

  • Operating location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
  • Displayed country: Pakistan (PK)
  • Sources: Viewstats, Wikipedia (Geo Entertainment infobox lists headquarters as Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan)

(5) LANGUAGES:

  • Primary language: Urdu
  • Secondary: English subtitles provided on many videos; auto-translation available
  • Source: YouTube Creator Blog; Wikitubia

(6) PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY:

  • Pakistani entertainment television: drama serials, feature films, telefilms, original soundtracks (OSTs)
  • Category ranking: #15 Entertainment globally, #1 in Pakistan
  • Source: Viewstats, Wikipedia (Geo Entertainment)

(7) CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL:

  • Broadcaster archives / own-production model: The channel uploads full-length episodes of all original Geo TV productions daily (30–40 uploads per day). Content is produced internally and through partnerships (notably 7th Sky Entertainment, co-founded by GMD Abdullah Kadwani). Early uploads (2008–2014) were largely removed in a 2017 cleanup.
  • Source: YouTube Creator Blog, Wikitubia

(8) REPRESENTATIVE SERIES:

  • Khuda Aur Muhabbat (Seasons 1–3, 2011–2021): Spiritual-romantic drama; OST has 320M+ views; Season 3 had ~2 billion views on YouTube
  • Khaani (2017–): Feroze Khan & Sana Javed; became Netflix addition; major international success
  • Meri Zaat Zarra-e-Benishan (2000s classic): One of earliest recognized dramas
  • Deewangi, Dil-e-Gumshuda (17.0 TRP), Munafiq (22.75 TRP record), Kahi Unkahi, Bharosa Pyar Tera, Mohabbat Tumse Nafrat Hai, Piya Naam Ka Diya, Ramz-e-Ishq, Yaariyan, Meharposh, Kahin Deep Jalay, Rang Mahal
  • Source: Wikipedia (Geo Entertainment), Khuda Aur Muhabbat Wikipedia page, YouTube Creator Blog
